entry.title: First-in-Class Mutant-Selective JAK2 V617F JH2 (NCT06313593, INCB160058) & Type II DFG-Out (NCT06343805, AJ1-11095) Clinical Benchmarks
entry.summary: Phase 1 trials of INCB160058 (NCT06313593, mutant-selective JH2 pseudokinase binder; PDB 4FVR, 6E2Q, 8BAK vs WT 4FVP) and AJ1-11095 (NCT06343805, Type II DFG-out inhibitor breaking Type I persistence) validate structural druggability while leaving catalytic JH2 PROTAC degraders wide open.

entry.title: Post-JAKi Salvage White Space After IMpactMF (NCT04576156) Overall Survival Futility Halt
entry.summary: Oct 2026 IDMC Overall Survival futility discontinuation of Phase 3 IMpactMF (imetelstat, NCT04576156) leaves relapsed/refractory post-ruxolitinib myelofibrosis (median OS 11-23 months) open for clonal-eradicating and zero-washout add-on combinations (POIESIS NCT06479135, SENTRY NCT04562389).

entry.title: Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF) 74-80% Fibrosis Reversal & Dual Transfusional / IL-6-Hepcidin Iron Axis
entry.summary: JAK2/CALR/MPL-negative Autoimmune Myelofibrosis achieves 74-80% hematologic and histological reticulin fibrosis remission on corticosteroids or rituximab alongside resolution of IL-6 -> hepcidin -> ferroportin macrophage iron trapping, providing an in-vivo human positive control against persistent clonal PMF stroma (GSE156644, GSE144568).
